IS: 12115 (Part 2) -1987 



Indian Standard

SPECIFICATION FOR 

COUPLINGS FOR DISPOSAL OF SEWAGE WATER 

FOR INLAND VESSELS 

PART 2 QUICK-RELEASE COUPLINGS 



o 

Q. 



1- Scope — Lays down the requirements for quick-release couplings with a union nut to connect 
storage containers to the piping for disposal of sewage water for Inland vessels. 

2- Dimensions — The dimensions of quick-release couplings, end piece, bush and gasket shall 
be as given in Fig. 1 to 4 respectively. 

3. Materials 

3.1 The parts of couplings shall be made from steel or any other equivalent material. 

3.2 The gasket ( dia 150 x dia 106 x 6 thick ) of quick-release coupling shall be made of oil and 
petrol resistant soft rubber.

4. General Requirements 

4.1 The limit deviations of dimensions and the surface roughness of parts of couplings shall meet 
all the requirements to ensure leak-proof joints. 

4.2 The conventional pressure for quick-release couplings shall be 0*6 MPa ( 6 kgf/cm^ ). 

5. Designation 

5-1 The couplings and its parts shall be designated by; 

a) Name of the coupling or its parts, 

b) Number of Indian Standard, 

c) Group of coupling ( B2 for quick release coupling for sewage water ), and 

d) Number of coupling or its part containing the type of coupling and the part ordinal 
number. 

Example — see Table 1 below. ^

Bush cover IS : 12115 ( Part 2 ) Bs2i 
Cover ISI : 12115 ( Part 2 ) Bssa 
Gasket IS : 12115 (Part 2) B225 

6. Marking 

6.1 The couplings shall be marked with manufacturer's name or trade-mark and its designation. 
6.1,1 Standard marking^ Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard gives the requirements for couplings for disposal of sewage water used for 
inland vessels. The type of coupling is chosen depending upon the use of vessels and the system 
of polluted water transfer and treatment adopted In its operationaf area. This part of the standard 
deals with quick-release couplings consisting of two parts; a bush and an end-piece ( with a union 
nut ) which is fixed on the bush by turning the hand wheel. 

This standard is being issued in the following parts: 

Part 1 Flange couplings, 

Part 2 Quick-release couplings, 

Part 3 Adapters— (Flange/end piece), and 

Part 4 Adapter— Flange/bush. 

Notwithstanding what is stated in the standard, the rules and requirements laid down by 
Classification Societies and Statutory Authorities in all respects shall apply. 

This standard is based on ISO 7608-1985 *Shipbuilding — Inland navigation — Couplings for dis- 
posal of oily mixture and sewage water', Issued by the International Organization for Standardiza- 
tion( ISO ). The ISO standard classifies the couplings for sewage water under Group B and further 
sub-classifies the quick-release couplings as Type 2. The same method of classification is used 
in this standard for the sake of uniformity.
